title: विशाल नेपाल काव्यमा जातीय सांस्कृतिक चेतना
nepali: वासुदेव त्रिपाठीको विशाल नेपाल काव्यमा केकस्तो जातीय सांस्कृतिक चेतना पाइन्छ भन्ने मूल समस्यामा आधारित प्रस्तुत अध्ययन सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनको सैद्धान्तिक आधारमा गरिएको विश्लेषण हो । गुणात्मक विधिमा रहेको प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा विशाल नेपाल काव्यको विषयगत सन्दर्भसहित जातीय सांस्कृतिक चेतनाको विश्लेषणात्मक पर्याधारमा रही विश्लेषणात्मक र वर्णनात्मक लेखन गरिएको छ । नेपालको अस्तित्वको सुरुवाती समयदेखि अस्तित्वमा रहेका सम्पूर्ण जातजातिको एकताको भावना र यस देशको प्राकृतिक, भौगोलिक र सांस्कृतिक चेतनाले ती जातिमा उत्पन्न गरेको विशालबोधको भावनाले नेपाललाई एकसूत्रमा बाँध्न सकेको ऐतिहासिक तथ्य विशाल नेपाल काव्यमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको र जातीय सांस्कृतिक चेतनाका साथै राष्ट्रियता र देशभक्तिको भावनालाई यस काव्यले समेटेको अध्ययनको निष्कर्ष रहेको छ । नेपालको जातीय संस्कृतिको वैभवलाई ऐतिहासिक सन्दर्भका साथ प्रस्तुत गरिएको यो काव्य नेपालको इतिहास र यहाँका जातजातिको गरिमा र गौरवलाई एकसाथ प्रस्तुत गरिएको सुन्दर कृतिका रूपमा चिनाइएको छ । यस अध्ययनमा वासुदेव त्रिपाठी राष्ट्रप्रेमको केन्द्रीयतामा जातीय सांस्कृतिक चेतनालाई एक सुन्दर काव्यमा प्रस्तुत गर्न सक्षम कवि हुन् भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: The present study, based on the core problem of what kind of ethnic cultural consciousness is found in Vasudev Tripathi's Vishal Nepal Kavya, is an analysis carried out on the theoretical basis of cultural studies. In this qualitative study, analytical and descriptive writing was carried out within an analytical framework of ethnic cultural consciousness, including the thematic context of the Vishal Nepal Kavya. The historical fact that the feeling of unity of all the castes and ethnic groups existing since the early days of Nepal's existence, and the natural, geographical and cultural consciousness of this country, produced in those groups a feeling of vastness (Vishal-bodh) capable of binding Nepal into a single thread, is presented in the Vishal Nepal Kavya; and the study's conclusion is that this poem encompasses, along with ethnic cultural consciousness, the feelings of nationalism and patriotism. This poem, which presents the glory of Nepal's ethnic cultures with historical context, is recognized as a beautiful work that presents together Nepal's history and the dignity and pride of its castes and ethnic groups. In this study, the conclusion has been drawn that Vasudev Tripathi is a poet capable of presenting ethnic cultural consciousness, with patriotism at its center, in a beautiful poem.
british_english: The present research, founded on the central question of what kind of ethnic cultural consciousness is to be found in Vasudev Tripathi's Vishal Nepal Kavya, is an analysis undertaken on the theoretical basis of cultural studies. In this qualitative piece of research, analytical and descriptive writing was carried out within an analytical framework of ethnic cultural consciousness, together with the thematic context of the Vishal Nepal Kavya. The historical fact that the sense of unity of all the peoples and ethnic groups existing since the early days of Nepal's existence, and the natural, geographical and cultural consciousness of this country, gave rise in those groups to a sense of vastness (Vishal-bodh) able to bind Nepal into a single thread, is set out in the Vishal Nepal Kavya; and the conclusion of the study is that this poem embraces, alongside ethnic cultural consciousness, the feelings of nationalism and patriotism. This poem, which presents the splendour of Nepal's ethnic cultures with historical context, is recognised as a beautiful work presenting together Nepal's history and the dignity and pride of its peoples and ethnic groups. In this study, the conclusion drawn is that Vasudev Tripathi is a poet capable of presenting ethnic cultural consciousness, with patriotism at its centre, in a beautiful poem.
australian_english: The present study, built around the core problem of what kind of ethnic cultural consciousness is found in Vasudev Tripathi's Vishal Nepal Kavya, is an analysis done on the theoretical basis of cultural studies. In this qualitative study, analytical and descriptive writing was done within an analytical framework of ethnic cultural consciousness, including the thematic context of the Vishal Nepal Kavya. The historical fact that the feeling of unity of all the castes and ethnic groups that have existed since the early days of Nepal's existence, and the natural, geographical and cultural consciousness of this country, produced in those groups a feeling of vastness (Vishal-bodh) that could hold Nepal together in a single thread, is presented in the Vishal Nepal Kavya; and the study's finding is that this poem also takes in, along with ethnic cultural consciousness, the feelings of nationalism and patriotism. This poem, which presents the richness of Nepal's ethnic cultures with historical context, is recognised as a beautiful work that brings together Nepal's history and the dignity and pride of its castes and ethnic groups. In this study, the conclusion has been reached that Vasudev Tripathi is a poet capable of presenting ethnic cultural consciousness, with patriotism at its centre, in a beautiful poem.
informal_english: This study, built around the question of what kind of ethnic cultural awareness you find in Vasudev Tripathi's Vishal Nepal Kavya, is really an analysis grounded in cultural studies theory. It's a qualitative piece, and the writing's both analytical and descriptive, working within an analytical framework of ethnic cultural consciousness alongside the thematic context of the poem. The study's conclusion is that the poem presents the historical fact that the sense of unity among all the peoples and ethnic groups around since Nepal's early days, plus the country's natural, geographical and cultural awareness, gave those groups a sense of vastness (Vishal-bodh) that could bind Nepal into one thread; and that the poem also takes in nationalism and patriotism alongside ethnic cultural consciousness. The poem's seen as a lovely work that presents the glory of Nepal's ethnic cultures with historical context, bringing together Nepal's history and the dignity and pride of its peoples and ethnic groups. The study reckons Vasudev Tripathi is a poet who's able, with patriotism at the heart of it, to present ethnic cultural consciousness in a beautiful poem.
